text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services has been directed by North York Community Council to investigate and report back on a speed limit reduction on collector and minor arterial streets in Ward 16 from 50 km/h to 40 km/h. The review disclosed the implementation of a 40 km/h speed limit is recommended on six streets to address safety concerns expressed by the Ward Councillor and area residents.

North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Ledbury Street, between Fairlawn Avenue and Lawrence Avenue West. 2. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Ledbury Street, between Old Orchard Grove and Melrose Avenue. 3. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Ridley Boulevard, between Old Orchard Grove and Deloraine Avenue. 4. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Roselawn Avenue, between Bathurst Street and Chaplin Crescent. 5. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Woburn Avenue, between a point 141.1 metres west of Elm Road and Ledbury Street. 6. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Yonge Boulevard, between Brooke Avenue and a point 55.8 metres northwest of McNairn Avenue.
